headlines.title_en: The Ministry of Commerce: China and Switzerland are accelerating their respective domestic procedures to implement the upgraded free trade agreement as soon as possible.
headlines.summary_en: Jin10 Data, August 27 - The Ministry of Commerce held a regular press conference. Under the arrangement of the upgraded free trade agreement, China and Switzerland have made high-level two-way opening commitments in goods, services, investment and other areas. In goods trade, both sides' share of imports with final zero tariffs exceeds 99%. At the same time, both sides upgraded and improved rules of origin, trade facilitation and other contents, agreed to strengthen cooperation on standards and conformity assessment, which is conducive to promoting further development of bilateral trade. In services trade and investment, the upgrade of the agreement is conducive to promoting China's exports of producer services to Switzerland; and to providing high-level investment access and a more stable, transparent, and predictable business environment for investors from both sides. At the same time, the two sides will also carry out broader and deeper cooperation in digital trade, artificial intelligence, sustainable development, supply chains, pharmaceuticals, machinery industry, watches and other fields.

headlines.title: 商务部回应美考虑对华额外加征7.5%关税
headlines.summary: 商务部27日举行例行新闻发布会，商务部新闻发言人黄玲在回应有关美国政府考虑对自中国进口商品额外加征7.5%关税的提问时说，美方以“产能过剩”为由对包括中国在内的16个经济体发起301调查，将经贸问题政治化，是典型的单边主义、保护主义行为，中方对此坚决反对。我们将继续密切关注并全面评估美方后续举措，并保留采取一切必要措施的权利。（新华社）

headlines.title_en: Ministry of Commerce responds to U.S. consideration of an additional 7.5% tariff on China.
headlines.summary_en: The Ministry of Commerce held a regular press conference on the 27th. In response to a question about the U.S. government considering imposing an additional 7.5% tariff on imports from China, spokesperson Huang Ling said that the U.S. launched a 301 investigation against 16 economies including China on the grounds of 'overcapacity,' politicizing economic and trade issues, which is typical unilateralism and protectionism, and China firmly opposes this. We will continue to closely monitor and comprehensively assess the follow-up measures of the U.S. side and reserve the right to take all necessary measures. (Xinhua)

headlines.title_en: Ministry of Commerce: After the upgrade of the China-Switzerland free trade agreement, zero-tariff imports on both sides will exceed 99%.
headlines.summary_en: The Ministry of Commerce held a regular press conference. A reporter asked that recently, China and Switzerland completed the upgrade negotiations of the China-Switzerland Free Trade Agreement and signed a memorandum of understanding. Please introduce the relevant situation and how to promote deeper and more practical China-Switzerland economic and trade cooperation next. In response, spokesperson Huang Ling said that under the arrangement of the upgraded free trade agreement, both sides have made high-level two-way opening commitments in goods, services, investment and other areas. According to the introduction, in goods trade, the share of imports with final zero tariffs on both sides exceeds 99%. At the same time, both sides upgraded and improved rules of origin, trade facilitation and other contents, and agreed to strengthen cooperation on standards and conformity assessment, which is conducive to promoting further development of bilateral trade. In services trade and investment, the upgrade of the agreement is conducive to promoting China's exports of producer services to Switzerland, and to providing high-level investment access for investors from both sides.

headlines.title_en: New China Life Insurance: Actively increased equity holdings during the market adjustment in the first half of the year.
headlines.summary_en: At the 2026 interim results press conference for insurance, Chen Yijiang, President of Xinhua Asset Management under New China Life Insurance, responded to questions about the company's response to medium- and long-term funds entering the market, saying that New China Life Insurance continues to make good use of the long-term investment reform pilot opportunities while continuously increasing allocations to high-dividend base assets. During the market adjustment in the first half of this year, the company actively increased positions in dividend and new-quality productive forces equity assets, firmly acting as a value discoverer in China's capital market and a ballast for maintaining capital market stability. (Securities Times)

headlines.title: 1至7月我国机械工业生产实现较快增长
headlines.summary: 金十数据8月27日讯，今天从中国机械工业联合会获悉，今年1至7月份，我国机械工业生产实现较快增长。最新的数据显示，机械工业主要涉及的五个大类行业增加值同比均保持增长趋势。其中，通用设备制造业增长7.9%，专用设备制造业增长8.8%，汽车制造业增长7.2%，电气机械和器材制造业增长6.5%，仪器仪表制造业增长9.4%。在机械工业代表性产品中，今年1至7月份，金属切削机床累计产量为51万台，同比增长0.8%。工业机器人累计产量为63.5万套，同比增长28.5%。发电机组累计产量为20897万千瓦，同比增长2.8%。

headlines.title_en: China's machinery industry saw rapid output growth in the first seven months of the year.
headlines.summary_en: Jin10 Data, August 27 - Today, learned from the China Machinery Industry Federation that from January to July this year, China's machinery industry production achieved relatively fast growth. The latest data shows that the added value of the five major categories of industries mainly covered by the machinery industry all maintained growth trends year-on-year. Among them, general equipment manufacturing grew 7.9%, special equipment manufacturing grew 8.8%, automobile manufacturing grew 7.2%, electrical machinery and equipment manufacturing grew 6.5%, and instrumentation manufacturing grew 9.4%. Among representative products of the machinery industry, from January to July this year, cumulative production of metal cutting machine tools was 510,000 units, up 0.8% year-on-year. Cumulative production of industrial robots was 635,000 sets, up 28.5% year-on-year. Cumulative production of generator sets was 208.97 million kilowatts, up 2.8% year-on-year.

headlines.title_en: Ministry of Commerce: Bilateral trade between China and Kyrgyzstan reached $11.7 billion in the first seven months of this year, with rapid growth in exports of China's 'new three items' and electromechanical products.
headlines.summary_en: Jin10 Data, August 27 - The Ministry of Commerce held a regular press conference. A reporter asked that President Xi Jinping will make a state visit to Kyrgyzstan. How to evaluate the current effectiveness and future development prospects of China-Kyrgyzstan economic and trade cooperation? Spokesperson Huang Ling said that from January to July this year, the trade volume between China and Kyrgyzstan was $11.7 billion, with China's 'new three items' and electromechanical products exports to Kyrgyzstan growing rapidly, and cooperation in services trade, cross-border e-commerce and other areas continuing to advance. Second, investment and economic and technical cooperation continue to deepen. China is Kyrgyzstan's largest source of foreign investment. As of the end of July this year, China's total direct investment in all industries in Kyrgyzstan exceeded $2 billion. Projects in large infrastructure, energy, minerals, agriculture, green development and other fields are progressing smoothly. Third, economic and trade negotiations are effectively advancing. The negotiations on the China-Kyrgyzstan Services Trade and Investment Agreement have made important progress; at the same time, both sides are actively exploring and promoting China-Central Asia and Shanghai Cooperation...

headlines.title: 美股异动丨港股收涨5%传导至美股，再鼎医药盘前涨超3%，机构看好下半年催化剂
headlines.summary: 再鼎医药港股今日收涨5%，带动再鼎医药(ZLAB.US)美股盘前涨超3%。 消息面上，公司在8月初公布的2026年第二季度财报是这轮行情的起点。增长主要得益于核心产品则乐的稳定表现，以及艾加莫德销量的持续攀升。艾加莫德第二季度收入达2320万美元，环比增长15%，公司已上调其全年收入指引至9000万至1亿美元。 花旗银行在财报后指出，二季度数据加强了其对中国业务下半年企稳的信心，并将目标价从44美元上调至45美元。中信建投等机构也认为，公司的自研管线正逐步进入临床价值验证阶段，核心催化剂有望在下半年密集落地。

headlines.title_en: U.S. stock movers: Hong Kong stocks' 5% gain spills over, Zai Lab up over 3% pre-market, institutions bullish on catalysts in the second half.
headlines.summary_en: Zai Lab's Hong Kong shares rose 5% today, driving its U.S. shares (ZLAB.US) up over 3% in pre-market trading. On the news front, the company's Q2 2026 earnings report released in early August was the starting point of this rally. Growth was mainly driven by the stable performance of the core product Zejula and the continued rise in VYVGART sales. VYVGART Q2 revenue reached $23.2 million, up 15% quarter-on-quarter, and the company has raised its full-year revenue guidance to $90 million to $100 million. Citibank noted after the earnings report that Q2 data strengthened its confidence in the stabilization of the company's China business in the second half of the year and raised its target price from $44 to $45. Institutions such as CSC Financial also believe that the company's self-developed pipeline is gradually entering the stage of clinical value validation, with core catalysts expected to materialize intensively in the second half.

headlines.title_en: CNESA: China's new energy storage cumulative installed capacity expected to grow at 20.7%-25.5% CAGR from 2026 to 2030
headlines.summary_en: Chen Haisheng, chairman of the China Energy Storage Alliance (CNESA), released data at the 11th Western China Energy Storage Forum: China's new energy storage cumulative installed capacity is projected to reach 200.7 GW in a conservative scenario and 221.9 GW in an ideal scenario by 2026; by 2030, it is expected to hit 371.2 GW and 450.7 GW, respectively. From 2026 to 2030, the compound annual growth rate is estimated at about 20.7% in the conservative scenario and 25.5% in the ideal scenario. (Shanghai Securities News)
